name: Chemical Crystallography
description: Introduction to symmetry in the solid-state, basics of X-ray diffraction and crystallography, single crystal X-ray diffraction, powder X-ray diffraction, their applications in pharmaceutical and material science, practical aspects of X-ray data collection, crystal structure solution and refinement, crystallographic disorder, twinning, powder profile fitting versus Rietveld refinement, brief introduction to advanced topics such as total-scattering pair distribution function analysis, and neutron diffraction. Practical training of powder XRD and single crystal XRD data collection procedure, modelling, visualization and analysis of crystal structures.
